notes.title: Third Crisis: Neon Nights - v0.1 Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h3]The wait is finally over! 💜[/h3][p][/p][p]Dive into a cyberpunk metropolis as the mercenary, Zoey Madison. Find a way to navigate the seductive and corrupt Neon City. Choose who to trust, what to desire, and how far you'll go. Are you in it for the pleasure? Or will you stay pure?‎[/p][p][/p][p]A new story for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1260820/Third_Crisis/"]Third Crisis[/url] - our other title on Steam - enjoyers or newcomers![/p][p][/p][h2]Play the demo today ♡[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"][/img][/p][p]Zoey's latest contract takes her to the Glowing Hole: a brothel in the Red Light District of Neon City. There are three distinct ways for Zoey to accomplish her task.[/p][p][/p][p]Plus... an especially [b]perverted[/b] way to end it. 👀[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy experiencing them all![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/dde3cbcd7710152b736a70447ded8f074dd8ba48.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/f300046add56758501126f3b107996a18d09e5da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/793d826ac57cbd796d855499eb432424110f81fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/6f10a4004896b5bace74115fac491d5dbbf6cdeb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/85b91f0ede9ad09e01e71ba7c3cd31957a17ee9f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"][/img][/p][p]We've put our hearts and souls into this release, utilizing everything we've learned from Third Crisis to completely blow our previous game out of the water. From animated overworld characters to fully voice-acted dialogue, this is truly an evolution of what you loved from Third Crisis and more.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this demo and stick around to see what the game looks like in the years to come![/p][p][/p][h2]Play the demo today ♡[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, we are actively developing the game, so make sure to hop onto our [url="https://discord.gg/tsCUtu4jNA"]Discord[/url] if you want to follow our progress or chat with us![/p][p]Your feedback and support will help shape the ultimate cyberlust experience.[/p][p] [url="https://discord.gg/tsCUtu4jNA"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/813f5c501e5e9155eba35e2e48f4af9ece689fd7.png"][/img][/url][/p][p] [/p][h3]With Love,[/h3][h3]Anduo Games ♡[/h3][p]
[/p][p]
[img src=""][/img][/p]

notes.title: Pick Up the Phone ❤️🌹
notes.content:
[h1]Rosas Are Red is Launching In 1 Day[/h1]
Hope our message finds you red, hehe o////o
The release date is near, are you excited?
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dFIFFHk.gif[/img]
 We thought it would be useful to gather all the useful release related information in one place and also take a moment to look back.
[list]
[*] [b]Launching:[/b] Monday 6th November 2023, 9 AM CET/ 4 AM EST
[*] [b]Platform:[/b] Steam (Windows, Mac, Linux)
[*] [b]Price:[/b] 9,99 $
[*] [b]Launch Deal:[/b] 10% off (Available also in a bundle with Third Crisis) 
[*] [b]Lewd levels:[/b] Very lewd
[/list]

[h2]How YOU can cum & help[/h2]

Most Steam launches success is determined a lot before even the game launches. It is dependent on the wishlists.

To put it simply:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36645784/772489cf87853c539c82e790689663a6336c69c0.png[/img]
Catto is Steam. Steam is asleep until launch - if Steam does not see wishlists then it does not wake up to go and get the game that the wishlists are coming from.

Here are some of the things you can do to poke the catto:
[list]
[*][b] Buy Rosas Are Red at launch.[/b] Doing that tells Steam that the game is loved and that it should visit too.
[*] [b]Leave a positive review.[/b] This tells Steam that the game is good and it’s worth promoting.
[*] [b]Tell all your lewd friends![/b] The more coomers the Steam page gets the more delicious it will look to the Steam algorithm. As in “This game makes us money. I will put it on the front page."
[/list]

We have also made some banners and avatars that you can pick up through this [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KXmC60W8N7D2-eMYcJyewwrxDNIaBJS6?usp=sharing]Google Drive[/url] to  show support and hype up the game release together with us!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36645784/aa917d729508b9bd974e46efe095778d47448662.png[/img]
Thank you for all the amazing support so far - we would not have gotten this far without you.
This is the final push for RAR before launch - let’s make the most out of it together!♡

Wish you an amazing weekend and let’s turn red on the 6th!ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
